Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.22.1 keeps the v0.22 multiplayer-driving path and fixes two-seat ATV, speedboat and off-road car riders: the driver's movement is captured before native rider processing, both riders keep independent seat offsets, horizontal view remains free, and mounted players retain aim, attack, interact and block-use inputs. Tank turret state is replicated separately and remote fire remains server-validated; explosive projectiles are never created by ordinary clients. Existing crops, ecology, creatures, furniture and vehicle resources remain included. Android/7723 multiplayer behavior is pending real-device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
